title: launch-contract
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

generated_by.description: The logical component that wrote the draft, with its version

promotion.description: Proof of promotion: the logical component that promoted, and the hash of the canonical launch contract without `status` and `promotion`

repository.description: Root, revision, whether the tree is dirty

authorized_roots.x-type-in-words: List of text, at least one

features.description: Per feature: path, slug, phases, task count, artifacts present and absent

sources.description: Per source: path, kind, content hash, for a task list also the hash that ignores checkboxes, line count
sources.x-type-in-words: List of records, at least one

inventory.description: Tasks, shell candidates, prerequisites, verification documents

relaunch.description: Relaunch budget: maximum of relaunches (0 to 5, default 2) and wall-clock seconds. It applies to every mode

learning.description: The binding of learning: mode, bound of decisions, their hash, effective values, source

verification.description: The verification mode the derivation set

comment.description: Hash of the consumer's comment, and what was changed because of it

scopes.description: Declared write scopes of tasks, and declared reads and writes of verification commands, each with its source

coverage.description: Per coverage obligation: id, source with path, line and anchor, kind (`implementation`, `prerequisite`, `verification`, `decision`, `operation`), timing, producer, disposition (`mapped`, `optional`, `out-of-scope`, `unresolved`, `unsupported`), stage ids, verification ids, rationale, evidence

findings.description: Per finding: id, severity (`info`, `warning`, `blocker`), status (`open`, `resolved`, `accepted`), message, source, resolution, and for a judgment the provenance of the answer

stages.description: Per stage: id, kind (an id of the registry of stage kinds), dependencies, working directory, action, action on resume, preconditions and postconditions (each a check of the registry, with its timing), recovery, evidence

action.description: Argument list (at least one entry), environment (a literal, or a value taken from a named variable with whether it is required), time limit in seconds (default 3600)
action.x-required: For kinds that run a command

recovery.description: Maximum of stage attempts (default 1), exit codes to retry, backoff, total time limit, and the reason rule: which stop reasons of the terminal record allow a retry (members of annex E §E.3 that are transient)
